scope: Per-invocation timestamped training output, including resumed runs; collision rejection; completed-run discovery; launcher compatibility.

tests.environment: CPU; rerun outside filesystem sandbox after local multiprocessing socket creation was denied
tests.shell_syntax: bash -n passed for training launcher, shared inference launcher, legacy inference entry and all three single-GPU entries

verified: Repeated launches in the same second receive distinct output names.
Old and timestamped checkpoints resume to a new directory without accumulating old suffixes.
Resume retains optimizer schedule configuration and save_every=250.
A repeated checkpoint save fails before altering existing weights, RNG, configuration or latest metadata.
Directory reservation errors reach nonzero ranks before any write.
Completed-run selection skips unfinished saves, honors custom checkpoint roots and supports legacy names.
Stage and inference launchers preserve explicitly selected checkpoint paths.
limits: No real GPU training or distributed NCCL save was launched for this change.
Already-started training processes keep the code and output paths loaded at startup.
